# A falling object

<!-- STEP id="table" -->
Drop an object from a height. Its velocity is 0, 9.8, 19.6, 29.4 and 39.2 m/s at 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 s.

<!-- STEP id="g" -->
It gains 9.8 m/s every second. That is a constant acceleration of 9.8 m/s², downward. It is caused by the Earth's gravitational force and is written **g**.

<!-- STEP id="origin" -->
Here the origin is the drop point, and down is the positive direction. You may choose the origin and the positive direction. Once chosen, keep them for the whole problem.
